topic: How violin body arch height and bow-string interaction each influence the sound a violin produces
title: A Violin's Shape Changes Its Sound
hook: So, why does a violin's shape matter?
description: Two recent reports look at different parts of violin sound: a controlled study compared instruments with different back arch heights, while a separate computer model examined how bow speed and pressure affect a vibrating string.
cover_payoff: Use a short original violin phrase as a listening payoff, with animated lines showing the string and body resonances. No creator performance recording is included, so the final scene must remain a clearly symbolic violin visual.
narration_script: So, why does a violin's shape matter? Researchers built six violins, changing only their back arch height. A separate model tested how bow speed and pressure affect sound. The measurements showed several body resonances shifted as the arch height changed.

narration_evidence.quote: Six violins were constructed to be as similar as possible, only the parameter “back arch height” was varied.

used the programming language Python to simulate a violin string, and then modelled the interaction between bow and string, investigating how changes in bow speed and pressure affect the resulting sound.
Signature body modes of the instruments were shifted apart in frequency and towards higher amplitude for lower back arch heights
